preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 10,000 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and 1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and 'N' not in line])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer N between 1 and 10^5 inclusive, representing the length of the string S.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for N, S in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and 'N' not in line], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
preconditions.description: Each string S has length exactly equal to its corresponding N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each string S contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and any(line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != 'YES'))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'NO' (impossible to make a palindrome) or 'YES' followed by a non-negative integer (minimum operations required).

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in output_lines or 'NO' in output_lines for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2)])
postconditions.description: Each test case's output is either 'NO' alone or 'YES' followed by a single integer line.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in output_lines and output_lines[1].strip().isdigit() and int(output_lines[1].strip()) >= 0 for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2) if 'YES' in output_lines])
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, it must be followed by a non-negative integer representing the minimum operations required.

postconditions.expression: all('NO' in output_lines for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2) if 'NO' in output_lines])
postconditions.description: If 'NO' is printed, it must be the only line for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(any(S[i] == S[N-1-i] for i in range(N//2)) or (N % 2 == 1 and all(S[i] == S[N-1-i] for i in range(N//2))) for N, S in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and 'N' not in line], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]) if 'NO' in stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2])
postconditions.description: If 'NO' is printed, the string S cannot be rearranged into a palindrome (i.e., it has more than one character with an odd count).

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[1].strip()) == min_operations for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[i:i+2] for i in range(0, len(stdout.splitlines()), 2) if 'YES' in output_lines] if (N, S) in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and 'N' not in line], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the integer is the minimum number of adjacent swaps required to make S a palindrome, where each swap uses two adjacent characters not used in any other swap.
